description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of feature categories across a dataset, with each slice corresponding to a specific feature and its proportional contribution. The chart is divided into 14 distinct slices, each labeled with its feature name and percentage value. The largest slice is labeled “from, 17.00%,” followed by “to, 14.50%,” and “genre, 13.50%.” Other notable segments include “name, 5.20%,” “size, 4.20%,” and “time, 4.10%,” each with clearly marked percentages. Smaller segments include “location, 3.80%,” “intent, 3.80%,” “destination, 3.00%,” “city, 2.60%,” “class, 2.40%,” “range, 2.20%,” “type, 2.00%,” “beds, 1.30%,” and “passengers, 1.10%.” The chart includes percentage labels directly connected to each slice via lines, and no legend is present. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the bottom right and moving counterclockwise. The colors of the slices vary, including shades of blue, green, yellow, and brown, allowing for visual distinction between categories.
